experiment: Entity-Bridge Retrieval: paired neural comparison and CPU like-for-like latency
note: Direct paired test of EBR against the cross-encoder, and of the cross-encoder on EBR's pool against the cross-encoder on Porter's pool. Same 1,000 qids, same model, same metrics, no tuning. Latency: both sides on CPU, cross-encoder timing includes the candidate construction it needs.

subset.selection: uniform without replacement from sorted test qids

cpu_latency.thread_note: EBR is numpy/CPU; the cross-encoder was reloaded on CPU with the default thread count. Both sides single process, same sample, no packer on either side.

contention_check.note: Same code both times. MPS contention accounts for only a small part of the published 23.3 ms vs this pass's EBR number; the rest is machine/thermal state.

cross_encoder_rerank_union_ms.note: one union of both top-100 pools per query, batch 32, max_length 512

gpu_latency_reference.note: GPU (MPS) rerank-only for the cross-encoder vs CPU end-to-end for EBR; not like for like.
